description: Distribution fidelity with/without defragmentation: for layers {6, 12, 18} of Qwen3.5-0.8B, perturbs hidden states along gauge, semantic, and random directions at scales {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}. Compares KL divergence between ground truth (full decoder forward pass) and three predictors: raw (J @ delta on token positions), gauge-free (J^(p) @ delta in p-space), and defrag-r (reconstructed J^(p) using top-r eigenvectors, r in {4, 8, 16, 32}). Measures distribution fidelity, TV distance, cosine similarity, and top-k agreement.
